ev.q: Among e-cigarette users aged 18–24 years, 16.3% were current smokers, 22.3% were former smokers, and 61.4% had never been cigarette smokers.
Among adult e-cigarette users overall, 29.4% also were current cigarette smokers, 40.3% were former cigarette smokers
In 2021, 4.5% of U.S. adults were current e-cigarette users.
Younger e-cigarette users were more likely to have never smoked cigarettes
Younger e-cigarette users were more likely to have never smoked cigarettes
Among those aged ≥45 years, 42.7% were current smokers, 50.1% were former smokers, and 7.2% had never smoked cigarettes.
With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
